sections.heading: What Causes Foggy Windows and Why Prompt Repair Matters
sections.body: Double- and triple-pane windows are filled with insulating gas and sealed at the factory to keep your interior climate stable. Over time, heat cycling, UV exposure, and normal building movement cause the edge seals to crack or deteriorate. Once the seal fails, outside air and humidity infiltrate the space between panes, leaving behind condensation, mineral deposits, and that telltale foggy appearance. Left unaddressed, the problem compounds: the insulating gas escapes entirely, thermal performance drops significantly, and you may begin seeing mold or etching on the interior glass surfaces. For property managers overseeing multi-unit buildings near Rosslyn or commercial developments along the Wilson Boulevard corridor, a single failed unit can quickly multiply across an aging window system. Acting quickly saves money, protects tenant comfort, and avoids the far greater expense of full window frame replacement.

sections.body: Our technicians begin every job with a thorough inspection to determine whether the insulated glass unit needs defogging treatment or full IGU replacement. We source high-quality tempered, laminated, and low-E glass units sized to your exact specifications and install them with precision using commercial-grade sealants and setting blocks. Every repair is tested for airtight seal integrity before our crew leaves the site. We work efficiently around occupied spaces, which is especially important for commercial clients in busy mixed-use corridors like Ballston or high-rise residential towers near the Potomac waterfront. Our team is fully licensed and insured, and we carry liability coverage that satisfies most property management and general contractor requirements.

faq.q: Can the foggy glass be cleaned or does the entire unit need to be replaced?
faq.a: In most cases the fogging cannot be permanently resolved by cleaning the exterior surface. The moisture and residue are trapped between the panes due to a failed seal. The most reliable and lasting solution is replacing the insulated glass unit, which we can usually do while keeping your existing window frame in place.

faq.q: How long does a foggy window repair take for a typical Arlington home?
faq.a: Most residential IGU replacements are completed in a single visit lasting one to three hours depending on the number of panes and the complexity of access. Commercial projects with multiple units are scheduled in phases and we provide a detailed timeline before work begins.

faq.q: Will new IGU glass match my existing windows?
faq.a: Yes. We custom-order replacement glass units to match your existing pane dimensions, glass type, thickness, and any tint or low-E coating present in the original unit. The finished result is virtually indistinguishable from the surrounding windows.
